name: dsh-thinking-phrase
description: Customize the running thinking label ("Deep diving for …"): four effects (static, typewriter, command line, decode with symbol or hex noise that can be mixed and drawn at random, at an adjustable pace), up to 25 phrases with a live count, placeholders for seconds, a spinner and a progress bar, random phrases, a random effect per phrase, and an optional typo that corrects itself. | 自定义会话进行中的「深度求索中，用时 …」提示文字：四种特效（默认、打字机、命令行、解码——符号块或十六进制噪声可混合随机且速度可调）、最多 25 条短语并实时计数、秒数/转动标记/进度条占位符、随机短语与效果、偶发错字自动修正。
